items.name: Sharon Bees Workshop
items.why: 4 for reach and 7 for inclusivity because it includes kids in the critters club only. response 10 because the students really engaged iwht the lesson, minimal iterations from feedback as there is not much, 10 for method because it was hands on annd 10 for reproducibility bc it doesnt use much fancy equipment and lesson plans are simple to reproduce.

items.name: Children's Book
items.why: 5 for reach as it is posted online but not advertised widely to the public, 10 for inclusivity because it is translated into multiple languages and is written in easy to understand language, also colorblind friendly and accessible online, response 8, received many feedback from stakeholders and students who enjoyed the book and their parents, 10 for iterations because we revised it multiple times through feedback for a better version. 10 for method as it is made digitally and is engaging and easy to distribute, 9 for reproducibilty, writing and illustrating a book for children is challenging but manageable.

items.name: Riverwatch Workshops
items.why: 8 for reach and 7 for inclusivity because it is advertised on social media and gained participation kids in middle school, 10 response because the students engaged and gave positive feedback later on, 10 for iteration because we gauged the interest and adjusted our lesson plan accordingly, 10 for method as it features fun experiments alongside the lesson, 7 for reproducibility as it depends on the materials available but the lesson is easy to reproduce.

items.name: Biotech Bootcamp
items.why: 9 and 8 for reach and inclusivity because students from many middle schools participated regardless of their background knowledge because it was advertised online for all, 10 response as students showed positive attitude when participating in class and is eager to learn. 10 method as we featured many complex experiments that engaged the student to think along with other activities, 6 for reproducibility because it requires an amount of resource and background knowledge from camp instructures and infrastructure. theory is accessible to teach.

items.name: Pollinator Presentations
items.why: 4 for both reach and inclusivity because it is limited to science pathway students at lambert highschool. 8 response because participants showed positive response but a few werent interested. 3 for iterations as we received minimal feedback for and it could be further improved upon. 6 for method, a classic presentation and debate activity could be boring to many but it is an effort to have everyone think. 10 for reproducibility because it is easy to replicate the lesson

items.name: Connectivity Night
items.why: 6 for both reach and inclusivity because it is limited to middle and high school students in the area. Response 4 as a few students showed interest, but not enough to be successful. 7 for iteration because it had been in use for multiple years and went through a few changes to be more adequate. method 5 because it is only presenting a posterboard. Reproducibility 8 because it is easy to do but requires a sufficient audience

items.name: iGEM Human Practices Collaboration Call
items.why: 10 for both reach and inclusivity b/c it reached igem teams from around the world and all types of team from highschool to overgrad. 10 for response because everyone participated in answering prompts and gave constructive feedback. 7 for iteration as we received feedback that helped us shape the call to be better, method 9 bc we had people work together on answering prompts on a whiteboard and had a team discussion. reproducibility 10 because it is simple to set up

items.name: Hardware Experimental Results
items.why: Because Vapor-X reduces the pressure of the environment, samples are able to evaporate faster at a lower temperature. However, although Vapor-X was highly effective for most samples, some results showed that Vapor-X could not retain effectiveness for certain biomolecules. We considered safety into every aspect of the design, with overtemperature checks at the software level and overcurrent protection at the hardware level.

items.name: Safety Forms
items.why: When filling out the safety form, we took dedicated measures to make sure our project is safe and meets all requirements for both iGEM safety and general lab safety.

items.name: Wetlab Experimental Results
items.why: Our wetlab is aimed to be beneficial, however it could have potential offtarget effects.

items.name: Education Results
items.why: Our educational efforts prompted many students to be more mindful of their surrounding environments and promoted healthy practices that promotes sustainability. additionally we enforced safety policies where appropriate

items.name: Entrepreneurship
items.why: Our project is useful in the context of promoting agricultural production but may not be the most efficient way to do so, and we need to further consider implementation for our entrepreneurship to be completely accurate.

items.name: Contribution
items.why: Our project has promising results on the environment, although there might be some reluctance to implenment these solutions amongst beekeepers, our educational effort and frugal hardware contribute to a better environment and technoloy,
